'''Walkerskye Surveillance Network''' was a company that provided surveillance systems for a number of travel agencies, and a division of [[Sacul Industries Group]].<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This organization was mentioned only in an advertisement on the video screen found exclusively in the queue of ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' at [[Tokyo Disneyland]].<ref name="ST2" /> Since the technologies advertised are already established as products of other companies, Walkerskye likely only provided equipment to companies. The company's name is an obvious reference to "Skywalker."
